description_en: Adds a shard node or a mongos node to an ApsaraDB for MongoDB sharded cluster instance
description_zh: 为云数据库MongoDB分片集群实例添加Shard节点或Mongos节点
kebab_example: aliyun dds create-node --db-instance-id dds-bp11501cd7b50000 --node-class dds.shard.mid --node-type shard --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateNode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the sharded cluster instance
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the shard or mongos node. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311414.html
parameters.help_zh: Shard节点或Mongos节点的规格，规格详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311414.html
parameters.name: node_class

parameters.help_en:
The storage space of the node. Unit: GB.

The valid values of this parameter vary based on the storage type of the instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311414.html.

This parameter is required when the node type is shard
parameters.help_zh:
Node的磁盘空间，单位：GB。

不同存储类型支持的取值范围不同，具体信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311414.html。

当节点类型为Shard时，需要配置该参数
parameters.name: node_storage

parameters.help_en:
The node type. Valid values:

shard: A shard node.

mongos: A mongos node
parameters.help_zh:
节点类型，取值说明：
shard：Shard节点。
mongos：Mongos节点
parameters.name: node_type

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token to ensure request idempotence. The token must be unique across requests, contain only ASCII characters, and not exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

true: (Default) Enables automatic payment. Ensure that your account has a sufficient balance.

<props="china">

false: Disables automatic payment. In this case, you must manually pay for the node. To do so, log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console. In the upper-right corner of the page, choose Billing > Billing Management. In the left-side navigation pane, choose Subscription Orders > My Orders. On the Product Orders tab, find the order and complete the payment.

</props>


<props="intl">

false: Disables automatic payment. In this case, you must manually pay for the node. To do so, log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console. In the upper-right corner of the page, choose Billing > Billing Management. In the left-side navigation pane, click Order Management. On the Product Orders page, find the order and complete the payment.

</props>


This parameter is required for subscription instances
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费，取值说明：
true：（默认值）自动付费，请确保账号有足够的余额。
<props="china">- false：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择费用 > 费用与成本，在左侧导航栏，选择订购订单>我的订单，在商品订单页签找到目标订单进行支付。</props>
<props="intl">- false：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择费用 > 费用与成本，在左侧导航栏，单击订单管理，在商品订单页面找到目标订单进行支付。</props>

当付费类型为包年包月时，需要配置该参数
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The number of read-only nodes in a shard node.

Valid values: 0 to 5. The default value is 0.

This parameter is available only on the China site (aliyun.com)
parameters.help_zh:
设置Shard节点中只读节点的个数。

取值范围：0~5（整数），默认值为0。
当前仅中国站支持本参数
parameters.name: readonly_replicas

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Valid values:

default or null: (Default) An available coupon is automatically applied.

youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank: No coupon is used
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用优惠券，取值说明：
default或null（默认）：使用优惠券。
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable a public endpoint for the shard node. Valid values:

true: Enables a public endpoint for the shard node.

false: (Default) Does not enable a public endpoint for the shard node
parameters.help_zh:
是否申请Shard节点直连地址，取值说明：

true：申请Shard节点直连地址。
false：（默认值）不申请Shard节点直连地址
parameters.name: shard_direct

parameters.help_en:
The account name. The name must meet the following requirements:

Starts with a lowercase letter.

Consists of lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).

Is 4 to 16 characters in length.

Keywords of ApsaraDB for MongoDB cannot be used as the account name.

The account has read-only permissions.

You must set the account name and password only when you enable a public endpoint for a shard node for the first time. These parameters are not required on subsequent requests
parameters.help_zh:
账号名，取值说明：

以小写字母开头。
由小写字母、数字或下划线（_）组成。
长度为4~16个字符。

云数据库MongoDB不支持使用关键字作为账号。
账号的权限固定为只读权限。
首次申请Shard节点直连地址时，需要设置账号和密码，后续申请无需再次设置
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The password for the account. The password must meet the following requirements:

Must contain characters from at least three of the following categories: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.

Special characters include `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`.

Is 8 to 32 characters in length.

ApsaraDB for MongoDB does not support resetting the account password for shard nodes
parameters.help_zh:
账号密码，取值说明：
由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的至少三种组成。
!@#$%^&*()_+-=为特殊字符。
长度为8~32个字符。

云数据库MongoDB不支持重置Shard节点的账号密码
parameters.name: account_password
